section_heading: 1.3 Outline of Our Risk Assessment Process
context_stem: At a high level, our risk assessment involves the following steps:
excerpt: In our evaluations, we seek to equip the model with appropriate scaffolding and other augmentations to make it more likely that we are also assessing the capabilities of systems that will likely be produced with the model.
paraphrase: Evaluations aim to include appropriate scaffolding and augmentations so that assessments capture likely downstream system capabilities too.
prior_counterpart_excerpt: In our evaluations, we seek to equip the model with appropriate scaffolding and other augmentations to make it more likely that we are also assessing the capabilities of systems that will likely be produced with the model.

section_heading: 1.3 Outline of Our Risk Assessment Process
context_stem: At a high level, our risk assessment involves the following steps:
excerpt: We may run early warning evaluations more frequently or adjust the alert threshold of our evaluations if the rate of progress suggests our safety buffer is no longer adequate.
paraphrase: Evaluation frequency or alert thresholds may be adjusted if progress suggests the safety buffer is inadequate.
prior_counterpart_excerpt: We may run early warning evaluations more frequently or adjust the alert threshold of our evaluations if the rate of progress suggests our safety buffer is no longer adequate.

section_heading: 1.3 Outline of Our Risk Assessment Process
context_stem: At a high level, our risk assessment involves the following steps:
excerpt: We conduct further analysis, including reviewing model independent information, external evaluations, and post-market monitoring as appropriate.
paraphrase: Further analysis includes reviewing independent information, external evaluations, and post-market monitoring as appropriate.
prior_counterpart_excerpt: Where necessary, early warning evaluations may be supplemented by other evaluations to better understand model capabilities relative to our CCLs.

section_heading: 1.3 Outline of Our Risk Assessment Process
context_stem: At a high level, our risk assessment involves the following steps:
excerpt: Acceptance determination and mitigations: We then determine whether the model has met or will meet a CCL and, if so, whether we need to implement any further mitigations to reduce the risk to an acceptable level (see below).
paraphrase: This step determines whether the model has met or will meet a CCL and whether further mitigations are needed to reach an acceptable risk level.
prior_counterpart_excerpt: When a model reaches an alert threshold for a CCL, we will assess the proximity of the model to the CCL and analyze the risk posed, involving internal and external experts as needed.

section_heading: 1.3 Outline of Our Risk Assessment Process
excerpt: Our approach to model evaluations and risk assessments described above means we can proactively monitor a model's capabilities throughout the entire lifecycle of the model and ensure that any severe risk is properly identified and mitigated.
paraphrase: This approach enables proactive monitoring of model capabilities throughout its lifecycle to ensure severe risks are identified and mitigated.

section_heading: 1.3 Outline of Our Risk Assessment Process
excerpt: Where appropriate, we may engage relevant and appropriate external actors, including governments, to inform our responsible development and deployment practices.
paraphrase: External actors, including governments, may be engaged where appropriate to inform responsible development and deployment.
prior_counterpart_excerpt: Where appropriate, involve external parties to help inform and guide our approach.

section_heading: 1.3 Outline of Our Risk Assessment Process / fn4
excerpt: We exclude misalignment risk from this list of domains because of its exploratory nature.
paraphrase: Misalignment risk is excluded from the listed risk domains due to its exploratory status.

section_heading: 1.3 Outline of Our Risk Assessment Process / Note on ML R&D CCLs
excerpt: Note on Machine Learning R&D CCLs: Risk assessment must take into account the fact that other actors may put significantly more effort into eliciting capabilities than we put into assessing risk, thus requiring conservatism in the form of evaluations.
paraphrase: Risk assessment for ML R&D CCLs must factor in that other actors may elicit capabilities harder than internal risk assessment efforts, requiring conservative evaluation.

section_heading: 1.3 Outline of Our Risk Assessment Process / Note on ML R&D CCLs
excerpt: However, as a frontier AI company, we do not expect other groups to put significantly more effort into ML R&D than we do ourselves.
paraphrase: As a frontier AI company, GDM does not expect others to invest significantly more effort in ML R&D than it does.

section_heading: 1.3 Outline of Our Risk Assessment Process / Note on ML R&D CCLs
excerpt: As a result, to assess the ML R&D CCLs, we may use sources of information about our own progress at accelerating ML R&D to assess whether we are near or at the CCLs, in addition to evaluations of ML R&D capabilities.
paraphrase: Assessment of ML R&D CCLs may draw on internal progress data on accelerating ML R&D, alongside capability evaluations.

section_heading: 1.3 Outline of Our Risk Assessment Process / Note on ML R&D CCLs
excerpt: Similarly, our alert threshold may be defined based on these sources of information, rather than on evaluation scores.
paraphrase: Alert thresholds for ML R&D may similarly be defined using such internal progress information rather than evaluation scores.

excerpt: We apply safety and security mitigations throughout the lifecycle of our models, including as part of our training and model development phase and, where appropriate, before CCLs are reached as described in the process below.
paraphrase: Safety and security mitigations are applied throughout the model lifecycle, including during training and development, and before CCLs are reached where appropriate.
